GOAL: Add behavioral exact-SHA verification that successful canonical recovery emits required AuditLog and EventLog evidence atomically and fails closed if required evidence persistence fails.
SCOPE: tests/contract/freeze-recovery-audit.test.ts only if static oracle is reduced/retained as supplemental
packages/api/directives.ts only if behavioral test exposes an actual runtime defect
REQUIRED_BEHAVIOR: Successful non-replay recovery behaviorally emits AuditLog and EventLog evidence required by DOC-C §5.6.
Evidence includes incident_id, request_id, trace_id and successful recovery identity.
Required evidence is inside the same transactional recovery boundary.
Audit/Event persistence failure prevents successful recovery.
Idempotent replay does not fabricate a second transition or duplicate evidence unless active authority explicitly requires it.
FORBIDDEN_BEHAVIOR: Do not count source-text/literal presence alone as behavioral proof.
Do not invent additional canonical event names beyond active source/authority.
Do not weaken transaction rollback/fail-closed semantics.
Do not mutate NEXY.ai or direct integration head while worker isolation remains blocked.
ACCEPTANCE: Behavioral test asserts eventLog.create and auditLog.create calls for successful recovery.
Test verifies required correlation and success identity.
Negative test forces audit persistence failure and proves no successful recovery response/state commit.
Negative test forces event persistence failure and proves no successful recovery response/state commit.
Mutation/equivalent proof catches removal of either required evidence write.
UNBLOCK_CONDITION: Authoritative policy establishes a Git-valid isolated worker branch namespace or explicitly authorizes an equivalent isolation mechanism.
